connector.name: Hyperping
connector.registryDescription: Uptime, API and server monitoring with outages, reporting, on-call and status pages.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.hyperping.io over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.hyperping, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token. Create a read_only or read_write API key under Project Settings, API Keys.
